bullets.text: Gigabit IQ Crowdfunds £270,000 - **Gigabit IQ** seeks funds to expand its online safety-focused ISP services in the UK.
Vodafone Partners with Skylo - **Vodafone** collaborates with **Skylo Technologies** to enhance IoT connectivity via satellite.
TalkTalk Explores Sale Options - **TalkTalk** is negotiating to sell its consumer ISP unit and wholesale platform business.
NEC Innovates 5G Power Efficiency - **NEC** introduces a compact amplifier module to reduce power consumption in 5G networks.
AI Infrastructure Investment Rises - Telecom operators are increasing investments in AI infrastructure to meet growing demands.
Open Cosmos Launches LEO Satellites - **Open Cosmos** successfully launches its first satellites for a new low-Earth orbit telecom constellation.
Meta and Corning's $6bn Deal - **Meta** partners with **Corning** to supply fibre optic cables for AI data centres.
Intracom Telecom Expands with Nova - **Intracom Telecom** collaborates with **Nova** to enhance enterprise connectivity using 5G mmWave.
